messages:
Harper: Need a focused thread on audience segmentation + demo traffic routing for the June webinar. Two demos (latency path, migration path). Question: do we split registrants at sign-up or based on behavior?
Ibrahim: My vote is hybrid: sign-up preference + event-day behavior. let users pick an interest at registration (Latency vs Migration) then auto-assign based on their click behavior in prepromo.
Zoey: +1. Also recommend a soft gate: show the demo choice on landing, but override if the user watches >60% of the pre-demo clip for the other path. That way engaged users get the right demo.
Riley: Technical routing notes: we can implement with a cookie + header flag. Landing JS sets cookie demo_path=latency|migration. Our edge can add X-Redwood-Demo: latency/migration and downstream pages render correct CTA.
Harper: Love it. We'll need UTM patterns for reporting. Proposal: utm_campaign=jun23_webinar, utm_demo=latency|migration, utm_source=channel. Any objections?
Ibrahim: Fine. For A/B messaging upstream, let's test two hero lines per demo. Also segment repeats: existing trial users should default to migration path (higher intent).
Zoey: Also create priority cohorts: "enterprise-fit" (company_size>500, visited /pricing), "plg" (signup within 30 days), and "partner" (listed partner org). Enterprise-fit goes to SDR queue with high touch.
Riley: Routing mapping (quick):
```
cohort -> funnel
enterprise-fit & attended -> sdr-enterprise
plg & attended -> growth-nurture
partner -> partner-ops
attended+asked_q -> sales-rapid
```
Harper: For the demos themselves, we need a short pre-roll clip per demo (60s) that we can serve immediately if live demo fails. Who owns recording? Zoey can create both clips.
Zoey: I can produce the clips. Request: infra demo needs clear before/after numbers (latency p50, p95) and a 1-line takeaway. Migration clip needs checklist + time-to-migrate claim.
Ibrahim: Speaker availability: Mina (infra) can do live NA morning only; Jules (product) prefers EU afternoon. That impacts which demo gets prime live slot.
Riley: Suggest live slot mapping: NA-peak -> infra live, EU-peak -> migration live. Use recorded fallback for the other demo.
Harper: Rehearsal plan: two dry runs covering both peaks. Dry run 1: Jun 8 9:30am PT. Dry run 2: Jun 10 4pm BST. Each run 45m max. Include failure-playbook.
Ibrahim: Failure playbook specifics: if live demo stalls >90s, cut to pre-roll and storyteller does a live commentary. If audio cuts, switch to chat Q + continue. If both fail, record follow-up mini-demo and email attendees within 4h.
Zoey: Lead handling post-event: export attended list, mark cohorts and demo_path, then push to CRM with tags: webinar_jun23, demo_latency/migration, attended=true. Also attach watch_time metric.
Riley: Promo-bot: scheduling reminders, ticketing, and tracking. promo-bot: will send reminders at 72h/24h/1h and post RSVP counts to #marketing at 8am PT daily starting 7 days out.
promo-bot: Reminder templates uploaded; will also output CSV with engagement metrics within 6h after event.
Harper: Action items: 1) Zoey produce two pre-rolls by Jun 1. 2) Riley implement demo_path cookie + header and test on staging. 3) Ibrahim finalize cohort rules and SDR mapping. 4) Harper build landing with dual-demo toggle and UTM tagging. 5) promo-bot schedule reminders once speakers locked.
Ibrahim: Also: add an experiment flag to measure routing effectiveness: measure conversion by assigned demo vs chosen demo. We should know if routing increases conversions.
Zoey: Noted. We'll capture demo_assigned vs demo_chosen and track trial signups by cohort.
Harper: Great. If we lock speakers by EOD Friday we can run dry-run 1 next week. Thanks team. :rocket:
